items.prompt:
Coming to a discussion having read the material means being:
A) prepared
B) late
C) off-topic

Adding to a classmate's point is called:
A) building on their idea
B) interrupting
C) ignoring them

Changing your view when given strong evidence shows you are:
A) open-minded
B) stubborn
C) rude

A classmate makes a well-supported point you hadn't considered. The BEST response is to:
A) acknowledge it and adjust your view if the evidence is strong
B) ignore it
C) talk louder
items.answer: A) acknowledge it and adjust your view if the evidence is strong

steps: Be open to evidence. Key is A.
solution.answer: A) acknowledge it and adjust your view if the evidence is strong

items.prompt:
Why come prepared to a discussion?
A) so you can contribute informed ideas with evidence
B) so you can stay silent
C) so you can change the topic
items.answer: A) so you can contribute informed ideas with evidence

steps: Preparation enables contribution. Key is A.
solution.answer: A) so you can contribute informed ideas with evidence

items.prompt:
The best way to DISAGREE in a discussion is to:
A) politely challenge the idea with reasons
B) insult the person
C) refuse to listen
items.answer: A) politely challenge the idea with reasons

steps: Attack ideas, not people. Key is A.
solution.answer: A) politely challenge the idea with reasons

items.prompt:
Which contribution BEST builds on a classmate's idea?
A) 'Maya said the law helped cities; I'd add that it also reduced pollution, according to the article.'
B) 'That's wrong.'
C) 'Anyway, my turn.'
items.answer: A) 'Maya said the law helped cities; I'd add that it also reduced pollution, according to the article.'

steps: Extends with evidence. Key is A.
solution.answer: A) 'Maya said the law helped cities; I'd add that it also reduced pollution, according to the article.'

items.prompt:
A productive group discussion usually includes:
A) preparation, active listening, questions, and openness to new evidence
B) one person talking the whole time
C) everyone talking at once
items.answer: A) preparation, active listening, questions, and openness to new evidence

solution.answer: A) preparation, active listening, questions, and openness to new evidence
